newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Techs lead in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Techs lead in sluggish trade.

text.p: As the U.S. stock market rallied sharply Monday, individual equity options were left largely in the dust, with technology stock options getting the most attention, traders said.

"The market's up 80 points but you couldn't tell it by us," the head of one options trading desk said. The Dow industrial average .DJI was up 87 points, or 1.2 percent, at 7,256, just after 1100 CDT/1600 GMT.
The trader said most people coming in were buyers but he had not crossed anything sizable.
"We're not that busy," another options trader said. "The market rallies and everyone sits back and watches it."
He said day traders were driving up volume in International Business Machines Corp options but no major features stood out.
The IBM May 175 call was the most active option at the Chicago Board Options Exchange, with turnover of about 3,520 contracts.
Other busy IBM options included the May 170 call, the May 165 call and the May 170 put.
IBM shares were up 3-7/8 at 171-3/8. Volume topped 1.9 million shares.

In other action, several Hewlett-Packard Co options were busy, led by the May 50 puts, which traded 3,960 contracts. The May 55 call traded nearly 2,800 contracts and the May 55 put traded about 2,675.
Hewlett shares gained 3-1/4 to 57-3/8 on roughly 3.3 million shares.
Also in the sector, Compaq Computer Corp options were fairly busy as the stock rose 1-1/2 to 96-3/8. Turnover was roughly 1.95 million shares.
The Compaq May 95 call traded nearly 1,400 contracts.
On the put side, the Compaq June 80 traded 1,165, the May 95 put traded 1,125 and the June 85 traded 1,075.
Outside of the technology sector, Telebras options remained active, mostly on the American Stock Exchange, as the American Depositary Receipts continued to rally. Telebras gained 1-5/8 to 126-1/8.

At the AMEX, the Telebras May 125 call traded 4,600 contracts and the May 120 call traded 3,160. In the June series, the 130 call traded more than 1,900 and the 125 call traded 1,235. The May 125 and June 120 puts each traded 1000.
